purpose: Record concrete buyer-side criticisms, repository-level remediations and external gates without converting open risks into false PASS claims.

fixed_findings.problem: helios-mobile.js dynamically loaded feature scripts, including a stale bonus-confirm fallback, creating duplicate-version and hidden dependency risk.
fixed_findings.remediation: index.html is now the authoritative explicit loader for Bonus Confirmation and Dual-Stream Director; helios-mobile.js owns responsive presentation only.

fixed_findings.problem: Director resolution CSS could neutralize reel/cell transforms used by core/mobile presentation.
fixed_findings.remediation: Director v1.1 owns a dedicated helios-director-stage wrapper transform and does not override reel/cell transforms.

fixed_findings.problem: HELIOS_ARCHITECTURE still described project 1.12 and an obsolete single-tier purchased bonus while active product had tiered bonus, desktop fabric, adaptive/safety and Director layers.
fixed_findings.remediation: Canonical architecture advanced to schema v16 / project 1.16.0 and records current bonus, desktop, adaptive, safety, Director and production gates.
fixed_findings.regression_gate: strict due-diligence preflight checks architecture/package/status synchronization and current tier values

fixed_findings.problem: Status/test inventory and README did not describe the full active policy/presentation architecture and referenced older integrity evidence as if it were current context.
fixed_findings.remediation: PROJECT_STATUS v21 and README 1.16 explicitly list active modules, current authority boundaries and commit-scoped evidence semantics.

fixed_findings.problem: Due-diligence preflight checked desktop fabric/agent but did not inspect Adaptive Policy, Dual-Stream Safety, Director loader/authority or canonical architecture synchronization.
fixed_findings.remediation: Strict preflight now validates all active authority planes, exact bonus tiers, explicit loaders, DOM-injection boundaries, workflow hardening, transaction scope and security-document synchronization.

fixed_findings.problem: HELIOS Integrity executed non-strict preflight even though a strict mode existed.
fixed_findings.remediation: Workflow and npm audit:buyer use audit:preflight:strict.

fixed_findings.problem: Security documentation named removed helios-swarm-dispatcher as an active control and omitted new adaptive/safety/presentation threat classes.
fixed_findings.remediation: Threat Model and SECURITY now use Desktop Fabric/Agent trust boundaries and explicitly cover policy truth erosion, stale/forged safety evidence and Director authority/retention leakage.

fixed_findings.problem: A repository document labelled latest evidence can never recursively contain the run ID/digest created after its own commit without generating another commit.
fixed_findings.remediation: CI_AND_RELEASE_EVIDENCE records immutable baseline evidence and defines external exact-SHA run/artifact preservation as the authoritative closing process.

fixed_findings.problem: Pinned actions/upload-artifact v4 still used the deprecated Node 20 action runtime and GitHub emitted a forced Node 24 migration warning.
fixed_findings.remediation: Pinned upload-artifact to official v7.0.1 commit 043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a whose action.yml declares node24.
fixed_findings.regression_gate: strict preflight verifies the exact immutable action SHA

fixed_findings.problem: Bonus tier names were interpolated into innerHTML and externally supplied tier IDs were interpolated into a querySelector expression. Current repository-controlled demo config limited exploitability, but this was not acceptable for buyer-configurable/remote production evolution.
fixed_findings.remediation: Bonus Confirmation v2.3 normalizes tier IDs/text, renders dynamic tier metadata using textContent/DOM nodes, renders dynamic wheel result using replaceChildren, and removes dynamic selector interpolation.

open_external_or_production_gates.evidence: GitHub branch API reported protected=false during 2026-08-27 audit
open_external_or_production_gates.required_action: Enable branch protection/ruleset requiring HELIOS Integrity before closing or establish equivalent transaction freeze/change-control procedure.

open_external_or_production_gates.evidence: GitHub repository rulesets endpoint returned an empty set during 2026-08-27 audit
open_external_or_production_gates.required_action: Create and validate host-level ruleset before definitive closing.
Use signed release/tag or equivalent cryptographic attestation for final closing snapshot if agreed.
Replace presentation-layer stake-refund bridge before regulated production deployment.
Connect real provider adapter, authenticated agent transport, durable lease/replay state and authoritative receipt verification.
Run non-money sponsor/provider pilot and measure throughput, latency, failure/retry/verifier-reject rates, device-hours, watt-hours and cost/value per verified work unit.
Perform exact-snapshot independent reviews appropriate to transaction/deployment.
For real-money deployment define the authoritative production RNG interface, formal game mathematics, simulations and jurisdiction/test-lab certification on the exact production snapshot.

buyer_conclusion_if_repository_integrity: REPOSITORY_LEVEL_ARCHITECTURE_AND_DILIGENCE_PACKAGE_MATERIALLY_HARDENED; REMAINING MATERIAL RISKS ARE PRIMARILY EXPLICIT HOST_LEVEL_CLOSING_CONTROLS, REGULATED_GAME_CERTIFICATION AND REAL_PRODUCTION_PROVIDER_PILOT_VALIDATION, NOT HIDDEN_DOCUMENTATION_OR_PRESENTATION_AUTHORITY_DRIFT.
